mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 5.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the negative correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns vanishes (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4% for three consecutive months, accompanied by accelerating payroll growth, signals a late-cycle labor market overheating that precedes earnings downgrades and valuation compression, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for 3 consecutive months AND PAYEMS YoY growth > 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the correlation between the trigger and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with falling housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a deflationary shock with rising interest rates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals supply-side stress, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered months, or the effect reverses during a simultaneous demand shock.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 2% for two consecutive months, in the absence of a simultaneous recession signal (UNRATE > 5%), signals a supportive monetary environment that boosts risk appetite and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% for 2 consecutive months AND UNRATE > 5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the effect is not robust during periods of high inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in payroll growth (PAYEMS YoY > 4%) without a corresponding rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE stable) signals labor market tightness that precedes wage inflation and margin pressure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS YoY growth crosses above 4% AND UNRATE change over 3 months is within ±0.1pp
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the effect is absent during periods of high inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months, irrespective of monetary policy stance, signals weakening consumer demand and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate earnings sensitivity.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < previous month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the effect is not significant during holiday-adjacent periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly contraction in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) below their respective 6-month averages signals broad-based supply chain stress, which raises costs and reduces earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 6-month MA AND HOUST < 6-month MA in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered months, or the effect reverses during a concurrent demand surge.
